title: Freizeitzentrum Weisslahn Terfens
highlights: Generous swimming lake offering superb groundwater quality in the Inn valley
Extensive sports facilities including tennis courts, beach volleyball, and inline skating
Kids' adventure zone with interactive water wheels, playground, and sandbox
Shady lawn sections beneath mature trees and a lakeside restaurant
kurzbeschreibung: Freizeitzentrum Weisslahn in Terfens offers an idyllic swimming lake with clean groundwater and numerous sports opportunities.
beschreibung:
Sports and Swimming Oasis in the Inntal

The Freizeitzentrum Weisslahn in Terfens enjoys convenient transport links in the Tirolean Unterinntal and is a treasured meeting place for water sports enthusiasts, relaxation seekers, and active families. The approximately 4.5-hectare swimming lake is continuously fed by fresh groundwater, guaranteeing premier water quality.

Versatile Leisure Activities

In addition to the refreshing bathing lake, the area features well-maintained tennis courts, beach volleyball courts, and a skate park. Spacious sunbathing lawns with shady nooks invite guests to relax, while children conquer the adventure playground with its water wheel and climbing structures.
